title: Maximum Pell Grant as a share of a year at a public four-year college
cap: Maximum Pell award as a percentage of average tuition, fees, room and board (housing and food) at public four-year institutions, by federal fiscal year 1976-2010 (ACE from Education Department and College Board data); 2026 point is 2025-26, this book's arithmetic: $7,395 / $25,850 (College Board).
